messages:
matt: New hire blocked on redwoodctl after following mac quickstart. They did `brew install redwoodctl` then `redwoodctl auth login` -> success, but `redwoodctl local serve` returns "rpc: unauthenticated".

lina: likely config dir mismatch. Do they have XDG_CONFIG_HOME in their shell?

matt: yes, dotfiles set XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$HOME/.config. Token is at ~/.config/redwood/token. No ~/.redwood dir.

oliver: i hit this last week. CLI currently only looks at ~/.redwood unless REDWOOD_CONFIG_DIR is set. Homebrew recently started writing to XDG path.

matt: quick unblock was `ln -s ~/.config/redwood ~/.redwood` per eng slack. Works but annoying.

lina: two immediate asks: 1) add a note to mac quickstart to call out XDG vs legacy; 2) make binary probe XDG first then fallback to ~/.redwood. Also consider a `redwoodctl migrate-config` helper.

oliver: opened issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwoodctl/issues/1045 titled "config dir parity: prefer XDG_CONFIG_HOME, fallback to legacy ~/.redwood, add migrate tool". Adding e2e test and homebrew formula change.

build-bot: CI reminder: changing config lookup may affect tests that assume `~/.redwood`. Add test coverage for both envs.

devex-bot: suggestion: `redwoodctl doctor` command that prints resolved config dir(s), env vars, and token locations. Also log a friendly error suggesting `REDWOOD_CONFIG_DIR=...` or symlink when unauthenticated.

matt: will add repro steps + shell outputs to the issue and send a small blurb to onboarding docs. Keeping symlink for now. Thanks folks :thumbsup:
